newsitem.title: USA: Borden Foods to sell pasta plants to Primo Piatto.
newsitem.headline: Borden Foods to sell pasta plants to Primo Piatto.

text.p: Borden Foods Corp, a privately-held company, said Friday that it has reached a definitive agreement to sell the Borden Foods pasta plants at New Hope and Minneapolis, Minn., as well as the pasta distribution center in New Hope, to Primo Piatto Inc.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed, but the company said it expects the transaction to close on or about June 27.
Based in New Hope, privately-held Primo Piatto is a newly formed Minnesota company.
Borden said it did not know how many of the 224 employees involved would be offered new positions, but expected that "many" would continue to have jobs.
The company added that preserving jobs was the main reason it decided to consider the sale of the pasta plants. It said it could not continue to operate them because of severe losses in the business.
